ev.q: The Cosby Show is an American television sitcom
The show focuses on the Huxtable family, an upper middle class African-American family
The portrayal of Clair Huxtable, the matriarch of the Huxtable family, by Phylicia Rashad
originally aired on NBC from September 20, 1984, to April 30, 1992
with a total of 201 half-hour episodes spanning eight seasons
